newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: China gives $180 mln credit to Manila power firm.
newsitem.headline: China gives $180 mln credit to Manila power firm.

text.p: China's Shanghai Electric Corp signed a memorandum of agreement to grant a $180 million suppliers' credit to Philippines' Magellan Utilities Development Corp, the presidential palace said on Tuesday.
The credit was to partly finance the construction of Magellan's 300-megawatt power plant in Batangas, south of Manila.
The memorandum of agreement was signed during the state visit of Chinese President Jiang Zemin to the Philippines.

Another signing of a build-operate-transfer contract between Philippines' National Power Corp and a consortium led by China's Harbin Power Engineering Co Ltd was also done to coincide with Jiang's three day visit to the Philippines which began on Tuesday.
The consortium is to build a 200-megawatt coal-fired power plant in the southern island of Mindanao.
The two governments agreed to open additional consulates in the southern part of their respective countries and maintain the Philipine consulate in Hong Kong after the handover to China next year.
